plan.name: Example hunt plan
plan.intent: Enough structure to show the shape. Replace it with your own.

phases.name: Phase 0 — Planning
phases.intent: Know the terrain before touching it.

tasks.title: Survey and reconcile the terrain
tasks.intent: The inventory and reality drift. Establish which hosts actually answer before hunting on them.
tasks.evidenceExpected: A host list with presence recorded for every entry.

steps.text: Run the survey from a vantage inside each enclave.
Merge the vantages and strip DNS-cache noise.

tasks.title: Place network sensors
tasks.intent: Sensor placement decides what the whole mission can see.
tasks.evidenceExpected: A tap on every mission-critical path.

steps.text: Map mission-critical paths, then place taps.

phases.name: Phase 1 — Hunt
phases.intent: Look for the adversary on the terrain you just mapped.

tasks.title: Hunt for password spraying
tasks.intent: Many accounts, one password, low and slow. The audit gap that hides it is 4625 not being collected.
tasks.evidenceExpected: A single source authenticating against many accounts in a short window.

steps.text: Confirm 4625 is actually being collected before concluding anything.
steps.expect: A count per DC. A zero is an audit gap, not a clean result.

steps.text: Group failures by source, then by account count.
steps.expect: One source, many accounts, few attempts each.

tasks.title: Hunt for scheduled-task persistence
tasks.intent: Scheduled tasks survive reboots and rarely get reviewed.
tasks.evidenceExpected: A task nobody in the estate can account for.

steps.text: Baseline scheduled tasks across the estate, then diff.
steps.expect: A delta, not a wall of rows.
